research_question: Does the current V5 OOS evidence layer measure the realized paper trades of the five independent child books, or only the separate multi-leg bundle ledger?

source_contract.paper_v5_loop: scripts/paper_v5_loop.sh runs scripts/walk_forward_v4.py once per hour with --ledger $RUN_ROOT/bundle_ledger.csv and writes $RUN_ROOT/walk_forward.json.
source_contract.legacy_walk_forward: scripts/walk_forward_v4.py only admits CLOSED/UNWOUND bundle-ledger rows with positive entry_cash as OOS trades.
source_contract.v5_child_books: scripts/multi_strategy_paper.py runs each V5 sleeve in runs/paper_v5_live/strategies/<name>, reads each child status/fills/broker_state, and aggregates child equity, realized PnL, gross exposure and live positions.
source_contract.oos_publication: scripts/multi_strategy_paper.py publishes OOS fields from the single top-level walk_forward.json rather than reconstructing the child fills it otherwise aggregates.
source_contract.child_execution_files: src/engine.cpp persists signals.csv, fills.csv and broker_state.csv for each child book; fills contain BUY/SELL/SETTLE paper executions.

interpretation.confirmed: V5 can hold child-book positions and produce aggregate mark-to-market PnL while the official OOS gate remains at zero because the gate is fed only by the separate multi-leg bundle ledger.
interpretation.not_confirmed: The observed negative current runtime PnL is not yet a statistically valid strategy-level OOS estimate because child closed-trade lineage has not been reconstructed and cost-stressed by sleeve.
interpretation.impact: Cross-sleeve capital research such as PR #169 cannot be economically validated from the current top-level walk_forward.json alone.

bounded_challenger.entry_lineage: Bind each BUY to the latest same-market/same-side signal at or before the fill timestamp within a bounded lag. Future signals cannot backfill lineage.
bounded_challenger.realization: FIFO-match BUY lots to SELL/SETTLE fills; open inventory is never counted as realized OOS PnL.
bounded_challenger.base_costs: Use recorded paper entry/exit prices and recorded protocol fees.
bounded_challenger.stress: At 1.5x and 2x, subtract incremental recorded fees plus a configurable modeled slippage reserve on entry+exit turnover; base executable prices are not double-counted.
bounded_challenger.chronology: Report sequential forward folds using only already-realized paper trades; no future signal may select an entry.
bounded_challenger.coverage_ablation: Report legacy closed bundle inputs versus causally linked closed V5 child trades. This comparison is accounting coverage only, not alpha.
bounded_challenger.minimum_evidence: At least 30 causally linked closed child trades, at least two active chronological folds, majority-positive 2x folds, positive aggregate 2x PnL, zero missing entry lineage, and zero unmatched exits.

rollback_rejection_criteria: Reject economic conclusions if entry signal lineage is missing or can be backfilled from the future.
Reject economic conclusions if exits cannot be matched to prior paper inventory.
Do not count open mark-to-market positions as realized OOS trades.
Do not promote on accounting coverage alone; require positive cost-stressed realized evidence and incumbent/challenger ablation.
Do not modify config/live_champion.json, production thresholds, sizing, drawdown/OOS gates, deployment, credentials or authenticated execution from this research branch.

coordination.hf: No queue/fill/latency model is changed; PRs #105, #123 and #147 remain the HF owners.
coordination.lf: No PCA/reversion/semantic/external model is changed; LF research remains in #91, #106, #124, #128, #141, #165 and #171.
coordination.portfolio: This attribution layer is intended as missing evidence infrastructure for PR #169, not a competing capital allocator.
